October 6, 2026


To facilitate ongoing work for our Key Lake EMBARK Project, two crystallization circuit storage bins will be transported from Saskatoon to Key Lake from October 6-8. This transportation has a planned highway 914 North road closure - Pinehouse Junction to Key Lake mine - from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on the 8th. Regular traffic on the 914 will resume once the trucks reach Key Lake at approximately 6 p.m. on October 8.
